title: Understanding the Bootstrap Code
text: The bootstrap method involves resampling with replacement from the dataset. The second argument in the `sample()` function specifies whether sampling is done with replacement.

title: Sampling with Replacement
text: In the context of bootstrapping, we typically sample with replacement to create new datasets. This allows us to estimate the sampling distribution of a statistic.
